simple.meaning: שָׁאַן (shâʼan) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to loll , i.e. be peaceful.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 5 times across Job, Proverbs, Jeremiah, beginning at Job 3:18. Its contexts include family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁאַן (H7599).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שָׁאַן (shâʼan) / H7599 is traced through Job 3:18, Proverbs 1:33, Jeremiah 30:10, Jeremiah 46:27 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.usage: be at ease, be quiet, rest. See also 1052 .
definitions.full: H7599. shaan [ שָׁאַן ] verb Pa`lel (Ges § 55d ) be at ease or at peace, rest securely (Syriac pacify , Ethiopic peace ); — Perfect 3masculine singular שַׁאֲנַן Jer 48:11 , ׳וְשׁ consecutive 30:10 +; 3 plural שַׁאֲנָ֑נוּ Job 3:18 ; — be at ease, secure , undisturbed by ill fortune: מַחֲרִיד וְאֵין וְשׁ ׳וְשָׁקַט Jer 30:10 = 46:27 ; Jeremiah 48: (of Moab); ׳שׁ רָעָה מִמַּחַד Prov 1:33 ; of rest from trouble, etc., in grave Job 3:18 . שְׁאָן see שְׁאָן בֵּית . P. 112
